title: A bar for the monster under your mouse
changes: A bar at the top of the screen now tells you about the monster you point at: its name, level, health, what it is weak to, and anything special about it. Champions list each of their traits there.
Monsters no longer carry name tags. A health bar shows only when you point at one, or for 4 seconds after you or your group hurt it. Your own golems always show a small one.
Damage numbers are whole numbers, and floating words like Broken! no longer print on top of each other.
